result:
Round 315 is planned and handed off. The decision is CONTINUE, from baseline `abfcf78` with a clean tree.

**Round 314 result:** C passed all 10 rows with real browser checks and found 0 bugs. Gate 314 published `abfcf78`, so PERF-5a is done and C-R312-01 and C-R313-01 are closed. The old task is archived as `tasks/round-314.md`, a byte-identical copy.

**PERF-5b batching closed on evidence.** I measured it on a production build of HEAD, 3 loads each at normal and 6× slowed CPU:
- Each of the 9 peaks deliveries already produces exactly one React commit of 94 components.
- No long task comes from a peaks commit.
- Deliveries rarely land in the same frame: 2–3 of 8 at normal speed, none at 6×.

Batching would save at most 2–3 commits, so no exact perf check would show an improvement. performance-optimizer agrees. The cost of re-rendering 94 components per delivery is recorded for PERF-10. The remaining load long tasks go to PERF-11 and PERF-13. That means PERF-5's plan target of "no load task over 50 ms" will not be met by PERF-5 itself.

**Round 315 instead closes the five PERF-5 robustness Lows (A-R312-REVIEW-L1…L5):**
- **L1:** the peaks worker gets 10 s to send its first reply, then 3 s per reply, so a slow start no longer turns it off for the session.
- **L2:** an error thrown by a peaks callback is re-raised on a timer. It no longer stops the queue or marks the wrong source as failed.
- **L3:** a source's audio reaches playback and export only once it shows "ready". A library source that becomes ready during playback joins the playing mix.
- **L4/L5:** new test rows. A writes one more (PW19, the video path) in a new test file.

Both consults shaped the code: performance-optimizer found the error-rethrow hazard and the missing playback re-sync, and tech-lead's corrections were all adopted.

**My checks on the scratch copy:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Typecheck and Biome | clean |
| Peaks tests | 25/25 |
| Mutants | 10 of 11 fail as they should; the 11th is equivalent by design |
| The 8 covering test files | 97/97 |
| Full unit suite | 235 files, 3502 tests |
| Perf spec | 0 failures; all 164 exact rows equal C's round-314 run |
| Browser slow-start probe | at HEAD the worker is shut down after exactly 3 s; with the change it survives at both viewports, 0 page errors |

There is no visible UI change. Docs 228 and 163 are granted for the status and wording updates.

**Files updated:** `current-task.md`, `backlog.json` (version 274, decisions D-29z845…D-29z849), `feature-status.md`, `b-round-314.md` and `b-next.json`; evidence is in `b-round-314/`. The open signals are recorded, not scheduled: page-turn coverage moves to PERF-10, the stereo copy to PERF-13, and round 314's review notes (including its architecture note) are logged. `lessons.md` is unchanged.

The advisor was available and consulted three times; all of its advice was adopted.

**Next:** a REGRESSION round if round 316 is planned on or after 2026-11-05, otherwise PERF-7. RETRO is at round 320.
